checkpoint_selection: For each total-force budget B reached by the optimization, select the last stored path with counter_vectors.sum(axis=1) <= B. If the final optimization cost is below B, emit no value for B.
censoring_policy: A missing budget is stored as reached=false, source index=-1, attained N_F=-1, barrier=NaN and subdivisions=-1. It must not be plotted or imputed.

adaptive_barrier_protocol.energy_surface: real 0 K OpenMM potential energy surface

optimization_cost_axis: sum over all 22 image evaluator joint energy-force cache misses
